description: List invoices and credit notes with number, dates, status and totals. Free-text search covers subject, number, description, customer name and tags. filtermode: live, inactive, all, invoices, credits. To find one opportunity's invoices pass filters {"invoice_items_source_type_eq": "Opportunity", "invoice_items_source_id_eq": <opportunity id>} with filtermode all. Current RMS: GET /invoices.

filtermode.description: Built-in filter: live, inactive, all, invoices, credits.

filters.description: Extra Current RMS query-engine predicates, sent as q[<key>]=<value> (arrays become q[<key>][]). Examples: {"updated_at_gt": "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"}, {"number_eq": "003664"}, {"status_not_eq": 40}, {"work_email_address_eq": "abc@test.com"}, {"asset_number_eq": "ABC-1"}. Unknown predicates are silently ignored by the API.

search.description: Free-text search on subject, number, description, customer name or tags.

sort.description: Sort order, e.g. ["name asc"] or ["updated_at desc", "id asc"]. Add "id asc" when paging so the order is deterministic.

view_id.description: Record id of a saved custom view to apply.

name: current_rms_list_invoices
title: List invoices and credit notes
